wiki.title: Chandra Dillard
wiki.extract: Chandra Dillard (born March 10, 1965) is an American politician and the daughter of Moses Dillard. She is a member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from the 23rd District, serving since 2009. She is a member of the Democratic party. Dillard is the Deputy Minority Leader of the House. She serves on the Public Education Budget Subcommittee and the Sales & Use Tax and Income Tax Legislative Subcommittee of the House Ways and Means Committee.
